record.question: If the price of sugar is fallen by 5% a man can buy 220kg sugar. Find the quantity of sugar he was buying originally.
record.explanation: After 5% price fall, same budget buys 220 kg=old quantity/0.95; old quantity=220×0.95=209 kg. Independently reviewed solution; unofficial, not an examiner key.
